content.stem: 当金融行动特别工作组(FATF)将某个司法管辖区列入"受加强监测的司法管辖区"名单,也就是所谓的"灰名单"时,该司法管辖区:

options.A: 同意在接下来的12个月内参加金融行动特别工作组(FATF)的非周期性相互评估.
options.B: 必须缴纳罚款,方可在下一次金融行动特别工作组全体会议前从名单中除名.
options.C: 已承诺迅速解决金融行动特别工作组(FATF)相互评估中发现的不足之处.
options.D: 构成高度洗钱、恐怖融资和扩散融资风险,必须限制其进入国际金融体系.

content.stem_en: When the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) places a jurisdiction on the list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring, also known as the grey list, the jurisdiction:

options_en.A: Accepts to participate in an off-cycle FATF mutual evaluation to be held within the next 12 months
options_en.B: Must pay a fine to be removed from the list before the next FATF plenary
options_en.C: Has committed to swiftly resolving the deficiencies identified in a FATF mutual evaluation
options_en.D: Poses a high money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risk and must be restricted from accessing the international financial system
